tool.name: NCBI

configfiles.configfile: #slurp #import json #if str($database_name) #set taxonomy_value = str($database_name).lower() #set taxonomy_name = str($database_name) #else #set taxonomy_value = "taxdump-sha256-__NCBI_TAXONOMY_SHA256__" #set taxonomy_name = "taxdump (SHA-256 __NCBI_TAXONOMY_SHA256_SHORT__)" #end if #set table_separator = "," if $name_maps else "" { "data_tables": { "ncbi_taxonomy": [ { "value": #echo json.dumps($taxonomy_value)#, "name": #echo json.dumps($taxonomy_name)#, "path": "." } ]#echo $table_separator# #if $name_maps "ncbi_accession2taxid": [ { #if str($database_name) #set accession_value = $taxonomy_value #set accession_name = $taxonomy_name #else #set accession_value = "accession2taxid-sha256-__NCBI_ACCESSION2TAXID_SHA256__" #set accession_name = "accession2taxid (SHA-256 __NCBI_ACCESSION2TAXID_SHA256_SHORT__)" #end if "value": #echo json.dumps($accession_value)#, "name": #echo json.dumps($accession_name)#, "path": "." } ] #end if } }

param.name: database_name
param.label: Name for this database
param.help: Enter a unique identifier, or leave blank to derive one from the downloaded content

tool.help: Download a taxonomy dump from a provided URL. The default URL is the latest dump from NCBI taxonomy. The accession2taxid data comes from ftp://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pub/taxonomy/accession2taxid/ and can be used by the Diamond data_manager (uses ~20Gb as of 2021).
